verdict.rationale: Fireflies' marketing states that action items are generated automatically after every meeting, and speaker identification exists, so the core extraction is claimed. The evidence never says action items are tied to owners or collected in a trackable list. Pushing them to a tracker would mean building your own pipeline with Zapier webhooks or the API, and that path is only documented for whole transcripts. Missing for 10: owner attribution on action items, a central place to track action items across meetings, documented task-tool integrations (e.g. Jira/Asana), independent or hands-on corroboration.
